AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
June 11, 2014
7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Variance V 2014-07 Applicant: Oscar Castaneda
Location: 975 W. Bayless Sreet, Azusa, CA
Assessor Parcel Number: 8616-012-022
Variance to allow a permit for an increase in the rear lot setback coverage for a single family home, to expand an existing two-car, 400 square foot, garage into a four-car, 1070 square foot garage and storage area, from the allowed 35% lot coverage to the requested 61% lot coverage. This project is categorically exempt from further environmental review per Section 15303 New Construction of Small Structures of CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act).

Minor Variance V 2014-04 Applicant: Amy Hanlon
Location: 1732 Ranch Road, Azusa, CA
Assessor Parcel Number: 8684-044-001
Design Review and Minor Variance to allow a request for a 10% reduction in the rear yard setback from the required 25' to the proposed 23' to allow the legalization of a previously constructed game room at the rear of the property. This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Section 15303 New Construction of Small Structures of CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act).
